companyDescription.title: Company Description
companyDescription.text:
ALDI first entered the Australian grocery market in 2001 and has since grown to have almost 600 stores and 8 distribution centres in 5 states. If you’ve ever shopped at ALDI, you know we are not your average supermarket.  We’re also not your average employer. ALDI is a place where you’ll find good people, a good purpose, and good opportunities. You can work with a great team and feel great for making a real difference for everyday Australians and have a rewarding career.

It’s that simple. ALDI Good Different.

jobDescription.title: Job Description
jobDescription.text:
Are you ready to kick start your retail career? Join our Employer of choice, award winning retail team as a casual Junior Store Assistant at ALDI, where opportunities are endless!

At ALDI we do supermarkets a bit differently. With us, you’ll receive all the training you need to become a retail superstar and gain the confidence to set you up for success - now and into the future. Be part of a diverse and inclusive team that support one another in achieving our shared purpose - for our customers to live richer lives for less.

Junior Store Assistants are the backbone of our retail stores and keep our stores running by:

  • Assisting customers with finding their favourite products on the shop floor with a smile
  • Keeping our aisles organised, clean and looking fabulous  
  • Back of store duties including unloading and unpacking stock, keeping our shelves full so our customers can find their favourites!

qualifications.title: Qualifications
qualifications.text:
• The flexibility and availability to work on weekends, after school hours between 4pm - 9pm and during school holidays.
  • A positive attitude and eagerness to learn and grow.
  • A strong work ethic, you are known for being reliable.
  • A great eye for detail, with the ability to notice when things look out of place.
  • Enthusiasm to be part of a team and to understand the importance of being a great teammate.

additionalInformation.title: Additional Information
additionalInformation.text:
• Market-leading hourly rate relevant to your state and age, of $17.92 - $21.48 + shift allowances.
  • Join a company focused on sustainability. We’ve gone 100% renewable energy and our focus is Good Planet, Good Community, Good Health and Good Business.
  • Need support? Our confidential Employee Assistance Program is available to you and your family, free of charge.
  • Don't worry about aches and pains – we’ve got your back! We offer free physiotherapy for non-work-related issues.
  • We take pride in coaching and developing you as over 80% of leaders have been promoted internally.

Recruitment process

As this job is physical, your health, safety and wellbeing matter to us. Part of our recruitment process involves completing a medical check through a third-party provider. If you are under 18 years old, you are welcome to have a parent or guardian attend the medical check with you.

At ALDI, we celebrate diversity and are committed to creating an inclusive environment for all employees. We welcome applications from people of all backgrounds, experiences, abilities, and identities. To learn more, please visit www.aldicareers.com.au  

How to Apply

Upload a resume with your contact details and any extracurricular activities and/or work experience you may have.

With the opportunity to make a real difference to real people, ALDI is a place you’ll feel proud to work.
